gloss: to be crowded; to be busy

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {立|た}て{込|こ}みませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {立|た}て{込|こ}んでいなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {立|た}て{込|こ}んでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be crowded; to be packed
definitions.explanation: For a place to be densely crowded with buildings or people.

definitions.gloss: to be busy; to be swamped
definitions.explanation: To be occupied with many tasks or appointments in succession.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}て{込|こ}んで⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}て{込|こ}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's an area densely packed with buildings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}て{込|こ}んで⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{会|あ}えない→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I'm too busy with work to meet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}て{込|こ}んだ⟦{住宅街|じゅうたくがい}→住宅街：09394_juutakugai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I live in a residential area where the houses are packed close together.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}て{込|こ}んで⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{見|み}えない→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: The buildings are so densely packed that you can't see the sky well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{用事|ようじ}→用事：01520_youji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}て{込|こ}んで⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The end of the year was hectic because I was swamped with errands.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to set up) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (to become crowded)

TRANSITIVITY:
⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}て{込|こ}む: to be swamped with appointments
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}て{込|こ}む: to be busy with work
- ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}て{込|こ}む: buildings are densely packed

USAGE:
Often used to politely decline invitations or explain unavailability—implies being unavoidably busy.
